finding: The service enforced limits from 1 through 100, but both operator list routes exposed an unbounded integer in OpenAPI and accepted oversized values until service access.
change: Both operator list routes now declare FastAPI Query bounds ge=1 and le=100 with the existing default of 50. OpenAPI publishes the range and FastAPI rejects invalid values before invoking the service.
rollback: Revert the Query bounds and focused regression; no migration or persisted data changed.
limitations: The checks cover OpenAPI generation and in-process request validation only; they do not establish live proxy behavior or database/service availability.
